name: ares-critic
description: Deterministic, code-only grader. Scores each candidate for faithfulness, plain-text compliance, no invented indicators, citation coverage, low restatement, and the scenario-class boundaries. Below-threshold pairs are dropped (rejection sampling).
eval_mode: The same grader scores the trained model on the frozen test set (ares_train.evaluate / evaluate_hf), so a pair can't be accepted under looser rules than the model is later judged by.
notes: Artifacts extracted with regex and checked against evidence, Markdown detected structurally, token-run overlap measures restatement. Reproducible by construction.
